title: Biological characteristics, immune infiltration and drug prediction of PANoptosis related genes and possible regulatory mechanisms in inflammatory bowel disease.
authors: Zhang, Minglin; Liu, Tong; Luo, Lijun; Xie, Yuxin; Wang, Fen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究炎症性肠病中PANoptosis相关基因的生物学特征、免疫浸润及药物预测，仅提及转录因子预测而无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PANoptosis is one of several modes of programmed cell death (PCD) and plays an important role in many inflammatory and immune diseases. The role of PANoptosis in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is currently unknown. Differentially expressed PANoptosis-related genes (DE-PRGs) were identified, and pathway enrichment analyses were performed. LASSO regression model construction, a nomogram model, calibration curves, ROC and DCA curves were used to evaluate the predictive value of the model. Predicts transcription factors (TFs) and small-molecule drugs of DE-PRGs were analysed. Model genes and immuno-infiltration were analysed. The PANoptosis features of IBD include 12 genes: OGT, TLR2, GZMB, TLR4, PPIF, YBX3, CASP5, BCL2L1, CASP6, MEFV, GSDMB and BAX. The enrichment analysis suggested that these genes were related to TNF signalling, NF-kappaB, pyroptosis and necroptosis. Machine learning identified three model genes: OGT, GZMB and CASP5. The nomogram model, calibration curves, ROC and DCA curves have strong predictive value. Immuno-infiltration analysis revealed that immune cell infiltration was increased in patients with IBD, and the model genes were closely related to the infiltration of various immune cells. The TFs associated with DE-PRGs were RELA, NFKB1, HIF1A, TP53 and SP1. In addition, the Connectivity Map (CMap) database identified the top 10 small-molecule compounds, including buspirone, chloroquine, spectinomycin and chlortetracycline. This study indicate that DE-PRGs model genes have good predictive ability for IBD. Moreover, PANoptosis may mediate the process of IBD through TNF signalling, NF-kappaB, pyroptosis, necroptosis and immune mechanisms. These results present a new horizon for the research and treatment of IBD.
abstract_zh: PANoptosis是程序性细胞死亡（PCD）的几种模式之一，在许多炎症和免疫疾病中发挥重要作用。目前，PANoptosis在炎症性肠病（IBD）中的作用尚不清楚。本研究鉴定了差异表达的PANoptosis相关基因（DE-PRGs），并进行了通路富集分析。采用LASSO回归模型构建、列线图模型、校准曲线、ROC和DCA曲线评估模型的预测价值。分析了DE-PRGs的转录因子（TFs）和小分子药物预测。对模型基因和免疫浸润进行了分析。IBD的PANoptosis特征包括12个基因：OGT、TLR2、GZMB、TLR4、PPIF、YBX3、CASP5、BCL2L1、CASP6、MEFV、GSDMB和BAX。富集分析提示这些基因与TNF信号、NF-kappaB、焦亡和坏死性凋亡相关。机器学习识别出三个模型基因：OGT、GZMB和CASP5。列线图模型、校准曲线、ROC和DCA曲线具有强预测价值。免疫浸润分析显示，IBD患者中免疫细胞浸润增加，且模型基因与多种免疫细胞的浸润密切相关。与DE-PRGs相关的TFs包括RELA、NFKB1、HIF1A、TP53和SP1。此外，Connectivity Map（CMap）数据库识别出前10种小分子化合物，包括丁螺环酮、氯喹、大观霉素和金霉素。本研究表明，DE-PRGs模型基因对IBD具有良好的预测能力。此外，PANoptosis可能通过TNF信号、NF-kappaB、焦亡、坏死性凋亡和免疫机制介导IBD的进程。这些结果为IBD的研究和治疗提供了新的视野。
